title: FAT32 (File Allocation Table) signature
summary: A FAT32 volume boot record begins with a 3-byte jump (EB 58 90 or EB 3C 90), followed by the 8-byte OEM name. The FAT type is determined by the number of clusters: FAT12 (<4085), FAT16 (<65525), FAT32 (>=65525). The signature 0x55 0xAA at offset 510-511 identifies a valid boot sector.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Bytes per sector at offset 0x0B (usually 512), sectors per cluster at 0x0D.
FAT is the universal filesystem for USB drives, SD cards, and UEFI system partitions.
